collection_point: Eligibility screening and research invitation
denominator_and_join: Record screened eligible invited consented and randomized counts separately; consented trial cohort does not represent all eligible accounts automatically
missing_zero_rule: Unknown eligibility stays null and is not coded eligible
purpose: Establish recruitment denominator and external validity
access_and_privacy: Authorized minimized pseudonymous fields; consent precedes assessment and randomization

grain: One account and dated rights version
collection_point: Immediately before assignment
denominator_and_join: Join to immutable assignment registry; verify original Super without Lily access for C1; quota fields document actual rights and do not create a dose
missing_zero_rule: Unknown rights quota or level stays null; do not infer no access from missing record
purpose: Verify P0 and genuine access increment
access_and_privacy: Company authorization or informed participant observation; limited account observation does not establish population coverage

grain: Exactly one row per randomized account
collection_point: Before treatment configuration
denominator_and_join: Authoritative full randomized denominator including zero users; assigned_arm and pre_assignment_tier immutable; unique trial_id plus account_pseudo_id
missing_zero_rule: No assignment record means not randomized; do not reconstruct assignment from use or later tier
purpose: Preserve ITT and source of every downstream group join
access_and_privacy: Authorized immutable pseudonymous registry; assignment access hidden from raters

collection_point: Treatment enablement or control verification
denominator_and_join: Join original assignment; reconcile requested versus delivered rights in both arms; retain failed treatment configuration in T
missing_zero_rule: Missing verification is unknown delivery; configuration failure is observed failure and does not remove account
purpose: Verify treatment integrity and authorized recovery
access_and_privacy: Only authorized product operator can configure rights; preserve existing purchased rights

collection_point: Each entitlement message or Lily entry display
denominator_and_join: Account level funnel uses full randomized denominator; presentation version part of policy; join exposure to assignment
missing_zero_rule: Only verified delivery completeness permits zero exposure; missing client logs stay unknown
purpose: Separate entitlement allocation delivery visibility and attempt
access_and_privacy: Minimized telemetry; no raw message content required in public output

collection_point: Within frozen H_pre
denominator_and_join: Join all randomized accounts; baseline covariates measured before assignment only; period definition matched across arms
missing_zero_rule: Unknown score or incomplete telemetry stays null; verified complete inactivity may yield zero behavior counts
purpose: Plan variance and adjust pre-specified baseline while tracking displacement
access_and_privacy: Consent and authorized historical telemetry; publish aggregates only

collection_point: User begins Lily attempt
denominator_and_join: Join original group and original tier from registry; attempt denominator includes failed attempts; current plan is descriptive and never replaces original tier
missing_zero_rule: Observed failure is failure; absent records count as zero only after verified complete event coverage
purpose: Measure natural adoption failures crossovers and purchase-after-allocation use
access_and_privacy: Authorized telemetry; audio and transcripts excluded from public event export

collection_point: After sampled or complete attempt under frozen review plan
unit: Seconds words and validated categorical ratings
denominator_and_join: Use known review sampling design for aggregate mechanism metrics; all-account denominator for behavior; attempted-call denominator for quality; do not condition primary on success
missing_zero_rule: Unreviewed or invalid audio is unknown quality; observed zero expression differs from missing review
purpose: Distinguish autonomous useful expression from minutes word count or confidence
access_and_privacy: Separate secure consented audio store; blind reviewers; pseudonymous aggregate export

collection_point: All frozen baseline and follow-up course windows
denominator_and_join: Aggregate by original randomized account; original course time oral time and total learning time reported separately; no double counting overlapping time
missing_zero_rule: Zero course activity only if coverage complete; interrupted or missing logs do not become zero
purpose: Detect regular course displacement and total learning tradeoff
access_and_privacy: Authorized minimized activity logs; no lesson answers in public package

collection_point: Before assignment and frozen follow-up invitation
denominator_and_join: Schedule baseline and delayed unpractised-task follow-up for every randomized account including zero users cancellations and switches; invitations and compensation same rule
missing_zero_rule: No invitation or schedule is a follow-up failure not zero ability
purpose: Protect full follow-up and prevent task leakage
access_and_privacy: Consent before assignment; reviewers cannot access allocation or usage

collection_point: Independent baseline or delayed transfer assessment
unit: Calibrated continuous total score pending validation
denominator_and_join: Exactly one prespecified delayed primary score per account after fixed aggregation; join original registry only after blinded scoring is locked; parallel forms differ from practice and baseline wording
missing_zero_rule: Absent refused technically invalid or contaminated assessment is flagged per frozen rule; never score missing as zero
purpose: Unique primary transfer measurement and baseline; raw scale validity is a launch Gate
access_and_privacy: Secure consented recording separated from assignment; no identifiable raw speech in public output

collection_point: Every assessment due date and contact attempt
denominator_and_join: Original randomized cohort remains denominator; usage cessation tier switching and research withdrawal recorded separately; do not select completers
missing_zero_rule: Missing assessment remains null; no use may be observed even when assessment is missing; consent withdrawal respected
purpose: Prevent post-treatment selection and support prespecified missingness sensitivity
access_and_privacy: Contact details stored separately; no coercive follow-up; external practice descriptive not primary adjustment

grain: One unique transaction or refund adjustment
collection_point: All transactions within frozen H_B and maturity process
denominator_and_join: Join original assignment and tier; connect upgrade renewal and refund paths by unique keys; one economic transaction counted once; currency and recognition basis fixed
missing_zero_rule: No transaction is zero only with complete mature account ledger; missing receipt or unknown fees remain null
purpose: Full realized contribution and tier substitution within direct trial layer
access_and_privacy: Authorized financial data; pseudonymous records with no payment credentials

grain: One original account and complete H_B
collection_point: At mature financial lock
denominator_and_join: Every randomized account retained including verified no purchase; m excludes serving cost; cash or recognition rule frozen; annual nonrenewal opportunity not called retention failure
missing_zero_rule: Incomplete contribution stays null; quote price cannot fill m; observed complete no contribution may be zero
purpose: Direct both-arm full-period m means without adoption multiplier
access_and_privacy: Authorized financial aggregate; public output only permitted deidentified summaries

grain: One unique actual request including retries
collection_point: Every Lily or relevant baseline serving request within cost window
unit: Actual billable seconds tokens or request units
denominator_and_join: Join original account arm and tier; control existing usage included; offer and nonoffer paid tags mutually exclusive; count actual retries once each not both parent aggregate and child
missing_zero_rule: Failed requests may consume billable work; missing meters are unknown not free; verified unused account cost can be zero only with complete ledger
purpose: Capture both-arm baseline failures retries fallbacks and post-purchase calls
access_and_privacy: Authorized minimized service metering; no prompt audio transcript or credential export

grain: One account and complete cost period
collection_point: Invoice and telemetry reconciliation at H_B maturity
denominator_and_join: c includes all relevant actual serving once; mutually exclusive cost tags reconciled to bills; same H_B rules across arms; no shared hypothetical unit price
missing_zero_rule: Absolute observed serving cost nonnegative; delta cost may be negative; unknown costs stay null and cannot pass economic Gate
purpose: Direct both-arm c means and actual cost per effective expression with explicit denominator
access_and_privacy: Company contract and bill access required; public supplier price is not company paid cost

collection_point: On service issue or user report
unit: Incidents per attempt and per randomized account
denominator_and_join: Join original account; publish both attempt and account denominators; resolve overlaps with call and financial events without recounting cost
missing_zero_rule: No complaint only known with functioning reporting; silent users do not establish no quality harm
purpose: Operational and teaching guardrail escalation
access_and_privacy: Minimized issue categories; do not export identifiable complaint text

grain: One original-tier account and attributable exposure
collection_point: Only within separately authorized interference study
denominator_and_join: Separate original Free Super Max populations; same policy exposure and deployment scope; not identifiable from C1 original-Super account RCT alone
missing_zero_rule: Unmeasured original-Max effect remains unknown not zero; individual anecdotes do not estimate spillover
purpose: Requirements for future full-policy Max propagation and downgrade identification
access_and_privacy: Separate company authorization and approved identifiable design required

grain: One approved policy scope and period
collection_point: Before launch and before each expansion decision
denominator_and_join: Deployment N is matched policy population not trial N global MAU or normalized unit; F incremental only and deducted once; full spend includes serving other and fixed investment
missing_zero_rule: No budget N F or transport proof remains null; serving offer cap is not total spending cap
purpose: Separate learning investment budget direct economics and full-policy scale Gate
access_and_privacy: Authorized aggregate finance and eligibility counts; no personal detail required

grain: One randomized account and measurement domain period
collection_point: At each lock or data completeness review
denominator_and_join: Left join from immutable all-account registry to learning behavior billing and serving; expose missing rows rather than silently shrinking denominators
missing_zero_rule: Complete absence may imply zero only for relevant count or mature ledger; primary absent score always missing
purpose: Guarantee zero versus missing distinction and cross-file auditable denominators
access_and_privacy: Authorized data quality metadata; no secrets or raw personal identifiers
